description:
FILED s510b (Opus, 2026-10-07) from the #2777 handle-names table; perl 5.40.3.
  open(my $fh, '>:utf8', $T); binmode($fh, ''); print $fh "\x{e9}";     perl: c3 a9 (still :utf8)   PCL: e9
Same on input (':utf8' then binmode '' : perl still decodes).  Cause (read): %p-binmode-impl maps only NULL/undef to ':raw', but %p-layer-ef of '' returns the DEFAULT, which binmode passes as the byte format; an empty list names no layer, so perl changes nothing.  Pre-existing (base 3ea47a41 the same).
subject: `binmode($fh, "")` (an EMPTY layer string) pops the handle to bytes in PCL; perl keeps the layers it had
